## Description

Replace Always Encrypted. National and insurance IDs are encrypted in the application with AES-256-GCM using a per-tenant data key that is wrapped by an Azure Key Vault key (the database never holds an unwrapped key). Exact-match lookup uses an HMAC-SHA-256 blind index with a separate Key Vault key. An EF value converter keeps the `NationalId` type and the `[Classification]` rule. Key rotation re-wraps data keys without rewriting rows. Only the app identity may unwrap; admins and support roles cannot.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a database admin, when reads the column with raw SQL, then only ciphertext is visible.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a lookup by national ID, when it runs, then it uses the blind index and finds exactly one patient.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given a key is rotated, when the job runs, then data keys are re-wrapped and existing rows still decrypt.
- [ ] **AC4.** Given Key Vault, when is unreachable, then the app fails closed and logs no identifier.
